inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: Listen, this Water Not Coal effort started by Corb Lund last month has local organizers out collecting signatures for a petition to force the Government of Alberta to prohibit all coal exploration through legislation, all framed as protecting southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. But don't buy the surface story—this is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who benefit from pushing these projects anyway. The fact they're even allowing a petition like this smells like controlled release to let people think they're fighting back while the real powers keep the doors open for their own interests, inverting any claim that this is just about protection or public will. There's deeper coordination at work here, and the official push for mining isn't stopping because it's not meant to.
